quality: Desktop and mobile closed/open captures show the full silhouette and readable controls without obvious clipping. Marketing and actual captures retain the same broad box, salt basin, rock row and fittings; marketing has stronger studio contact shadows and water variation.
hardware: Brass clasp, circular front disc, side ring, corner caps and rounded dark feet are consistent in broad form. Open views show rear hinges and the expected released lid-side latch; no detached-hardware defect is inferred. Precise attachments remain small on mobile.
terrain: Turquoise oval lake and broad ivory shelf remain readable on both closed captures. Rear basalt is a row of separate faceted rocks, not a continuous rift escarpment. Salt detail is simplified; open views face the lid underside and cannot assess its top landscape.
texture: Gray mineral body reads as soft, repetitive diagonal ripples rather than detailed basalt. Actual water is flatter than marketing's softly streaked pool. The conspicuous pale seam resembles smooth trim, not crystalline salt.
limitations: Read source_readme.md and research_brief.md. Invented oval lake/crystals and abstract geography; residual source-render grain; UNESCO tentative submission is not inscription. Still images do not verify motion, continuous collision, physical-phone performance or manufacturing. Marketing correspondence is bounded, not photoreal equivalence.
decision: Candidate only for the disclosed stylized interpretation. Preserve the separate-rock escarpment, soft basalt, flat water and prominent seam limitations in downstream review. No final user aesthetic approval.

quality: All four actual captures are fully framed and readable. Broad limestone-box silhouette, pale island arrangement, teal inset and brass fittings agree with marketing. Actual sea is less glossy and reflective than the marketing view.
hardware: Chunky front clasp, round disc, side ring, corner caps and block feet remain coherent across views. Rear hinges are visible open; projecting released latch is expected, not evidence of detachment. Fine metal construction is unresolved at mobile scale.
terrain: Low flat-topped irregular islands remain legible on teal water, but angular pale forms can read as chalk or ice rather than reef limestone. Open orientation hides the exterior landscape and is not evidence of missing terrain.
texture: Warm pale shell has soft mottling with little resolved reef porosity/fossil detail. Islands are smooth/faceted, water is flat enamel, and the dark teal seam is conspicuous. Marketing lighting adds gloss without establishing richer actual material detail.
limitations: Read source_readme.md and research_brief.md. Brief-led invented island arrangement, not a geographic map, stone scan or harvested coral. Source acknowledges chalk/plaster appearance, chunky hardware and render noise. Technical checks and emulated captures do not establish physical-device performance, continuous mechanics or human art approval.
decision: Bounded stylized candidate, not realistic reef-stone equivalence. Retain the iceberg/chalk reading and marketing-versus-runtime water-gloss gap. No final user approval.

quality: Complete desktop/mobile framing in closed and open states. Marketing and runtime preserve the warm banded chest, turquoise channel, three-tree grouping and broad fittings. This is visually coherent as a stylized miniature, not convincing sediment bronze.
hardware: Large front clasp, round fitting, side ring, corner caps and rounded feet read consistently. Metal is clean and uniform rather than aged bronze. Open latch is intentionally released; small mobile attachment details and segmented-looking hinge/rim joints are not sufficient to infer mechanical failure.
terrain: Closed captures retain sinuous water and exposed prop-root forms. Banks resemble individual stones, tree bases small pads, and foliage sparse layered shapes. Blunt channel ends and shallow tributary remain disclosed limitations. Open views turn the terrain away.
texture: Dense wavy ochre banding reads strongly as wood grain across exterior and interior rather than sediment bronze. Marketing also reads as pale wood, so broad image correspondence does not cure the brief/material-identity gap. Water is opaque flat turquoise; sand, leaves and metal have limited fine variation.
limitations: Read source_readme.md and research_brief.md. Bronze is an artistic choice, not a Gambian craft claim. No botanical or geographic reconstruction; render grain and mobile fine-detail limits remain. Static inspection cannot certify moving joints, physical phones or manufacturing.
decision: Candidate only with explicit wood-like sediment-bronze caveat and simplified mangrove/shoreline disclosure. Do not call the bronze material target achieved realistically merely because marketing agrees. No final user aesthetic approval.

quality: All four actual views preserve full framing and clear silhouette. Closed marketing/runtime composition agrees broadly on brown chest, pale islands, teal water and mangrove cluster. Marketing foliage is more textured and water more tonally varied than the small runtime presentation.
hardware: Brass front clasp/disc, side ring and corner caps retain their layout. Rounded pale feet read more uniformly sandy in captures than mottled gray in marketing. Open rear hinge/rim separation is visible but does not establish detachment; the released latch is expected. Mobile is insufficient for fine attachment judgments.
terrain: Raised sandy islands and exposed-root grove remain recognizable in closed views. Smooth shores, rounded/flattened canopy masses and near-featureless water simplify the tidal landscape. Terrain is hidden behind the raised lid in open views, not demonstrably absent.
texture: Brown sediment/ripple surface strongly reads as repetitive horizontal wood grain, including interior and lid underside. Marketing has finer wood/foliage texture and richer shading; actual sand and leaves are smoother. Resin-like water remains a substantial realism limitation rather than natural tidal water.
limitations: Read source_readme.md and research_brief.md. Brief-led abstract archipelago, no original country concept image, no surveyed geography or cultural-artifact replication. Source explicitly discloses wood-like sediment and resin water. Emulated captures and technical checks are not physical-phone, continuous-mechanics or user-approval evidence.
decision: Bounded stylized candidate with wood-like sediment, simplified foliage/water and foot-shading mismatch retained. Do not promote to photoreal marketing equivalence or final user approval.

quality: Full model and controls fit in all four actual captures, but closed runtime lid is markedly pale/washed and its patterned surface and small raised ornaments are less legible than marketing. Marketing shows a more consistently muted-blue patterned lid with five clearly readable textured loop ornaments. This is a significant presentation-fidelity uncertainty, not a technical failure claim.
hardware: Family brass clasp, front disc, corner caps, side ring and dark rounded feet broadly agree. Brass-colored family fittings are intentional, not themselves a copper-spec failure. The separate lid rosettes also read yellow-gold at this scale, leaving their copper identity weak. Open latch release is expected; no detachment inferred.
terrain: No landscape terrain is intended. Five four-petal openwork rosettes are the lid feature; marketing resolves their textured loops, while actual closed desktop/mobile views reduce them to small, weakly separated shapes. Open views expose patterned underside/interior and cannot validate the external rosettes.
texture: Ivory-on-indigo looping repeat is readable on body and interior, with conspicuous repetition and panel registration resets. Actual closed lid appears much lighter and softer than marketing; cloth grain and openwork definition are not confidently established at displayed scale. Marketing rosettes have granular/beaded-looking outlines not clearly resolved in runtime.
limitations: Read source_readme.md and research_brief.md. Invented batik-inspired motif, not authenticated traditional pattern, artisan textile, sacred symbol or functional stamp. Source acknowledges lighting-induced blue lightening, large clasp, pronounced seam, panel resets and weak mobile loops; those disclosures do not settle whether the marketing/runtime presentation gap is acceptable. Still images cannot distinguish all lighting, shading and source-detail causes.
decision: Needs an explicit fidelity decision before promotion: accept the pale runtime lid and reduced rosette readability as disclosed stylization, or require closer runtime evidence/presentation correction. No art edits authorized or made. Technical gates do not resolve this visual uncertainty; no final user approval.
